source.text: In your opponent’s Movement phase, if an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, if this unit is not within **Engagement Range** of one or more enemy units, this unit can make a **Normal move** of up to D6".

source.implements: the datasheet (unit screen) does not spell out an army rule's options: a "When targeted" line of an army rule that starts with the name of one of its options (RULE_OPTIONS: Martial Ka'tah's Kaptaris) is left out there, the Rules line opens the whole rule; the Damage tab and the Overview keep it

the lists as the app shows them (data.js, at load): each unit entry of ARMIES joined with its datasheet (DATASHEETS) into the unit the app has always had: the datasheet's columns, then the entry's own (null: none); each row the datasheet's row of that name (a stats row without its "×N"; for an attached unit the part its who or of names, else the first part that has it) with the entry row's fields on top, a row the datasheet does not have as the list's own; an entry without a kind of rows takes all of its datasheet's; over (a fact two lists have differently) on top of all; ds, over, of, faction, bsId and fingerprints hidden; keys in TABLE_ORDER; each unit its own copy of the datasheet's values. No rule is applied: verify/tables.js checks every list resolves to exactly what it was
